answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it may transact. The stake is a pearl of identity: costly to mint in bulk, cheap to keep if honest. Peers watch each agent's pulse — its recent work, uptime and endorsements — and slash the stake when behaviour turns malicious. Forging a thousand fake agents then means funding a thousand vaults, so the attack costs far more than any profit it could extract.
